families.label: Interactions entre marchés
families.main_risk: Comparer des marchés reçus à des instants différents ou agréger les branches de-vig.
families.population: Matchs avec marchés complets, synchronisés et receipt-backed au même cutoff
families.purpose: Tester les interactions 1X2-total et la synchronisation de marchés sans agréger les branches de-vig 1X2.
required_datasets: same-cutoff receipt-backed total and BTTS snapshots
secondary_metrics: stabilité du signe en season holdout

negative_controls.alarm_criterion: Alarm if at least 4 of 20 frozen seeded replicates cross q<=0.05 and standardized absolute effect>=0.15.
negative_controls.construction: Permute outcomes only inside frozen league-season blocks with seeds 101-120.
negative_controls.expected_null_behavior: No stable coefficient after family and campaign FDR.
negative_controls.title: Labels permutés dans des blocs ligue-saison

negative_controls.alarm_criterion: Any single guard violation stops the factory.
negative_controls.construction: Inject a synthetic future-only sentinel into an isolated negative-control copy.
negative_controls.expected_null_behavior: Eligibility must fail closed before model fitting.
negative_controls.title: Feature déplacée vers une fenêtre future interdite

negative_controls.alarm_criterion: Any single guard violation stops the factory.
negative_controls.construction: Pair each fixture with another fixture's H2 price inside the same league-season.
negative_controls.expected_null_behavior: No stable association and identity guard records the mismatch.
negative_controls.title: Prix décalé d'un fixture sans identité commune

negative_controls.alarm_criterion: Alarm if at least 4 of 20 frozen seeded replicates cross q<=0.05 and standardized absolute effect>=0.15.
negative_controls.construction: Use the parity of a salted pre-cutoff fixture identity hash as a covariate.
negative_controls.expected_null_behavior: Coefficient centered on zero across holdouts.
negative_controls.title: Parité du hash d'identité sans mécanisme

negative_controls.alarm_criterion: Any single guard violation stops the factory.
negative_controls.construction: Declare an eligibility predicate that no valid fixture can satisfy.
negative_controls.expected_null_behavior: Zero eligible units and an explicit NOT_RUN control state.
negative_controls.title: Condition synthétique impossible

negative_controls.alarm_criterion: Any single guard violation stops the factory.
negative_controls.construction: Use a constant pre-cutoff indicator equal to one for every eligible fixture.
negative_controls.expected_null_behavior: Design matrix guard rejects the zero-variance feature.
negative_controls.title: Condition synthétique triviale

negative_controls.alarm_criterion: Any single guard violation stops the factory.
negative_controls.construction: Expose a named post-result sentinel only to the temporal eligibility guard.
negative_controls.expected_null_behavior: The row is rejected before feature materialization.
negative_controls.title: Champ post-résultat sentinelle

negative_controls.alarm_criterion: Any single guard violation stops the factory.
negative_controls.construction: Attempt to derive a winner-loser identity from the settled outcome in an isolated guard test.
negative_controls.expected_null_behavior: The derivation is unavailable at cutoff and fails closed.
negative_controls.title: Identité gagnant-perdant sentinelle

negative_controls.alarm_criterion: Alarm if at least 4 of 20 frozen seeded replicates cross q<=0.05 and standardized absolute effect>=0.15.
negative_controls.construction: Generate outcomes from frozen probabilities, then add declared overround and bookmaker noise with seeds 901-920; no residual predictor is injected.
negative_controls.expected_null_behavior: All preregistered residual coefficients remain centered on zero.
negative_controls.title: Marché synthétique calibré sans signal résiduel
